items.title: Playing catch-up on Monday/media day stuff I missed, and: man, Rob Dillingham going from "Minnesota traded up in the lottery to get him" to "guy traded twice in two days and waived at the end" in a little over two years feels pretty wild. Life's hard for a small guard.
